description_en: Modifies the bandwidth of a premium bandwidth plan
description_zh: 修改公网精品带宽的带宽大小
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-network-package-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-package-id np-cxj99qb8d34vo0000 --bandwidth 10 --auto-pay true --promotion-id 500033080110596 --reseller-owner-uid 1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNetworkPackageBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [](t2167755.xdita#)operation to query the list of regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service (EDS)
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the premium bandwidth plan
parameters.name: network_package_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth of the premium bandwidth plan, in Mbit/s.

- For subscription premium bandwidth, the valid range is 2 to 1000.

- For pay-as-you-go premium bandwidth with pay-by-traffic billing, the valid range is 2 to 200.

- For pay-as-you-go premium bandwidth with pay-by-bandwidth billing, the valid range is 2 to 1000
parameters.help_zh:
公网精品带宽的带宽大小。单位：Mbps。    

- 如果是包年包月精品带宽，则取值范围是2\~1000。
- 如果是按量付费精品带宽，且类型是按使用流量计费（PayByTraffic），则取值范围是2\~200；
- 如果是按量付费精品带宽，且类型是按固定带宽计费（PayByBandwidth），则取值范围是2\~1000
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the automatic payment feature
